format: A real CMS proton-proton collision, 8 TeV, 2012: run 195099, lumi section 115, event 137440354, a Higgs-boson candidate (H -> ZZ -> 2e2mu) CMS released for education. CMS frame, metres and GeV: x towards the LHC centre, y up, z along the beam (anticlockwise beam direction); the 3.8 T solenoid field points along +z, so a track of charge q turns clockwise (seen from +z) if q > 0, anticlockwise if q < 0, on a circle of radius R = pT / (0.2998 * 3.8) m. tracks: [key, q, pt, eta, phi, x0, y0, z0, pv, nHits, chi2ndof, aStart, aEnd, aCal, tag, x1, y1, z1, ux1, uy1, uz1, x2, y2, z2, ux2, uy2, uz2]. key: row in the file's Tracks_V2. (x0, y0, z0): the track's reference point, its closest approach to the beam (beside its vertex); pt, eta, phi there. The helix from it, by turning angle a >= 0, with h = -q: phi(a) = phi + h a; x = x0 + R h (sin phi(a) - sin phi); y = y0 - R h (cos phi(a) - cos phi); z = z0 + R a sinh(eta). aStart, aEnd: the turning angle at the track's innermost and outermost measured hit (where the tracker first and last saw it; aEnd can exceed pi for a curling track; aStart is near 0 except for a track first seen far out). aCal: the turning angle where the helix reaches the ECAL front (rho = 1.29 m or |z| = 3.18 m), or null if it does not within two turns (a looper, pT below about 0.74 GeV, that curls in the tracker). pv: index into vertices (nearest in z within 5 mm), -1 if none. nHits: tracker hits on the track. tag: 0 other, 1 muon, 2 electron. (x1, y1, z1, u1) and (x2, y2, z2, u2): iSpy's Extras, the innermost and outermost hit with the unit direction there; iSpy draws a track as the cubic Bezier p1, p1 + u1 s, p2 - u2 s, p2 with s = |p2 - p1| / 4 (good for under half a turn). The first nGood tracks are the drawn selection (nHits >= 8, chi2/ndof <= 5, transverse distance from the beam spot <= 0.01 m, the four leptons' tracks pass it), sorted by pt; the rest are the file's other reconstructed tracks (short, poorly fitted or displaced), also sorted by pt. vertices: [x, y, z, ndof, nGoodTracks] the reconstructed primary vertices (offlinePrimaryVertices); vertices[0] is the one the four leptons come from, the others are pile-up collisions in the same bunch crossing. beamSpot: [x, y, z]. calo: per calorimeter (EB/EE: the ECAL barrel and endcaps, lead-tungstate crystals; HB/HE: the HCAL barrel and endcaps; HO: the HCAL outer layer outside the solenoid; HF: the forward calorimeter at |z| 11-13 m) hits [E, eta, phi, fx, fy, fz, bx, by, bz, wf, wb]: rechit energy (GeV), its cell's front-face centre and back-face centre (the cell points back at the collision), and the mean edge of the front and back face; kept above min GeV, sorted by E; inFile and sumEInFile count every rechit the file stores. muons: each with its track (index into tracks), iSpy's propagated points (tracker and, where the propagation went on, the muon system), standalone: the muon system's own track [x1, y1, z1, ux1, uy1, uz1, x2, y2, z2, ux2, uy2, uz2], segments [kind, x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2] (DT barrel or CSC endcap chamber segments on its side), chambers [detid, front_1..4, back_1..4 corners] it crossed. In the return yoke outside the solenoid the field reverses (about 2 T), so a muon bends back there. electrons: each with its track, sc [E, x, y, z, eta, phi] its ECAL supercluster, gsf the GSF (bremsstrahlung-aware) track's Extras. otherSegments: muon segments not on either muon. jets: PF jets [ET, eta, phi] with ET >= 10 GeV (iterativeCone5PFJets). met: [pt, phi] PF missing ET.

source.recordTitle: Higgs candidate events for use in education and outreach
source.alsoIn: https://opendata.cern.ch/record/5200 (Hto4l_120-130GeV.ig: the same event, as selected by the open-data Higgs-to-four-lepton analysis example)
source.energy: sqrt(s) = 8 TeV proton-proton (2012, Run2012B: runs 193833-196531; run 195099 lumi section 115 is in the 8 TeV validated-runs list, https://opendata.cern.ch/record/1002)
source.dataset: CMS 2012 collision data, full reconstruction (RECO: generalTracks, hbhereco, ecalRecHit, dt4DSegments, cscSegments, offlinePrimaryVertices; CMSSW 5_3), an event display file made by CMS for education; triggered by single- and double-muon and muon-electron paths (e.g. HLT_IsoMu24, HLT_Mu17_Mu8, HLT_Mu8_Ele17)
source.selection: tracks: all 523 reconstructed (generalTracks) kept; the first nGood = 290 drawn (nHits >= 8, chi2/ndof <= 5, |dxy to beam spot| <= 0.01 m; the 4 lepton tracks pass it). calo rechits kept above {"EB": 0.25, "EE": 1.0, "HB": 0.5, "HE": 1.0, "HO": 1.0, "HF": 10.0} GeV. PF jets ET >= 10 GeV.
source.extraction: python3 -I ~/talks/.cache/opendata/r3/cms/data/extract_cms_event.py ~/talks/.cache/opendata/r3/cms/dl/f_4lepton_ig/4lepton.ig Events/Run_195099/Event_137440354 components/lhc-opening/event-cms.json --report ~/talks/.cache/opendata/r3/cms/data/report.txt (download: curl -L -o 4lepton.ig https://opendata.cern.ch/record/300/files/4lepton.ig; adler32 checked against the record)

physics.note: four-lepton invariant mass from the file's own muon and electron pT, eta, phi (GeV); record 300's 4lepton.csv gives 127.047752639 for this event

checks.note: every track's helix (its own pT, eta, phi, charge; B = 3.8 T along +z) run from its reference point passes its outermost measured hit within the median miss; with the field reversed it misses by the reversed median
